verdict.line: You lose if you eat a full Broken Wings-into-Ki Burst stun chain below 50% HP before level 6; you win once you bank Grit through her combo and answer with Show Stopper.

brief.thesis: This is a 48.5% win rate over 647 games because both champions win the fight the same way: by forcing the other to eat a stun first. Riven's W (Ki Burst) stun and your E (Facebreaker) stun are both short-cooldown lane-defining tools, so whoever lands their stun without eating the other's first gets the kill. Your structural edge is Sett's passive Pit Grit sustain (extra regen scaling with missing health) and W's damage-storage mechanic, which reward you for surviving her all-in rather than avoiding it.

theirWindow.when: she lands Ki Burst stun on you
theirWindow.what: This is her all-in window — Broken Wings resets into empowered Runic Blade autos will follow. Trade back only if you already have Grit banked in W (Haymaker) for the shield, otherwise back off and let your passive regen work.

yourWindow.when: after she uses Valor (E) to dash or block
yourWindow.what: Valor is on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown and has no offensive follow-up — step in immediately with Q (Knuckle Down) for the bonus max-health damage on your next two hits while she has nothing to escape or block with.

boots.why: 77% pick rate at 50.3% win rate — Riven's damage is almost entirely from Runic Blade-empowered autos, so flat physical reduction blunts every trade she starts.

runes.keystoneWhy: Runs at 48.1-51.1% here and stacks fastest in exactly the drawn-out melee trades this matchup produces, converting sustained damage into healing that outlasts her burst.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 82.9% of games at 48.7% win rate — Ignite punishes her all-in commitment before her passive regen or a back can save her, since neither of you has sustain items early.

playing.title: Only trigger E for the stun with a minion behind her
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if you have enemies on opposite sides of you — against just Riven in a 1v1, it will only slow her. Walk so a minion sits behind her before you E if you want the stun, not the slow.

playing.title: Bank Grit, don't dump W on cooldown
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) converts all stored Grit from damage taken into a shield plus true damage. Tank a hit or two from her combo first, then cast — casting on cooldown with no Grit stored wastes the shield.

playing.title: Punish the Valor cooldown window
playing.detail: Valor is 10/9/8/7/6s on cooldown with no reset. The moment she uses it to engage or block, she has no escape until it's back — commit your Q-E combo in that window.

playing.title: Take level 6 all-in seriously
playing.detail: Show Stopper lets you drag her off her wave and minions, which is why Sett holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup. Look for it the moment she overextends post-6.

playing.title: Check Conqueror stacks before committing
playing.detail: If she's been auto-attacking you for several seconds, her Conqueror healing is already ramped — disengage and reset rather than fighting into a healing enemy.

playing.title: Respect her first R cast, then punish the rest
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD/range and one Wind Slash. At rank 5 it recasts on a 10s cooldown, so late game she can poke repeatedly — close the gap fast after she fires it instead of walking into a second one.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, spells, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Check Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Use your abilities whenever the come off cooldown to deal damage. Use your lane sustain to gain control over lane.
